infobox.usage: Unlocks a safe in the blue chalet on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: USEC cottage second safe key (USEC 2) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the safe that belonged to one of the USEC operatives stationed in the roadside cottage area.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key unlocks a safe that is located in the south-western bedroom on the second floor of the blue chalet on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables)
- Virtex programmable processor
- VPX Flash Storage Module
- Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter
- Silicon Optoelectronic Integrated Circuits textbook

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The key also unlocks 4 erroneously locked and always empty safes on Streets of Tarkov. 3 in the Pinewood hotel rooms 206, 208 and 218 and 1 in the music room inside the game developer office.
